nodes.name: pgvector_plan_check.py
nodes.summary: Runs bounded EXPLAIN checks against representative pgvector queries and fails when the expected vector indexes are not used.

nodes.name: _vector_literal
nodes.summary: Serializes a numeric embedding into PostgreSQL vector literal syntax.

nodes.name: _fetch_plan
nodes.summary: Executes EXPLAIN for a representative vector query and returns the plan rows.

nodes.name: _plan_text
nodes.summary: Flattens structured EXPLAIN output into searchable plan text.

nodes.name: _uses_expected_index
nodes.summary: Checks whether an EXPLAIN plan references one of the expected vector indexes.

nodes.name: run_plan_check
nodes.summary: Connects to PostgreSQL, runs representative vector-query plans, reports index usage, and returns a process status.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses command-line options and exits with the pgvector plan-check result.
